{{Quote|Your victims were wrong, Uda-Khalid. It was a small target, but you had a heart after all.|Jedi Knight Mace Windu after slaying Uda-Khalid|<ref name="Survivors" />}}
Between around [[58 BBY/Legends|58 BBY]] and [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] undertook a '''mission''' to the [[Uda-Khalid's headquarters|headquarters]] of the mass [[Death/Legends|killer]] [[Uda-Khalid]] with the intention to bring him to justice. Windu successfully defeated Khalid in a duel, observed by the spirits of many of the [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid's]] victims.
